A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (12 November 2022). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998) with one change: a comma is added after “creature” (“character, creature, or vehicle”).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-atatcannon-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[AT-AT Cannon (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. The game text reads: “Use 2 Force to deploy on your AT-AT. May target a starfighter (use 3 as defense value), character, creature, or vehicle at same or adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a character or creature, 2 if a vehicle. Target hit if total destiny &gt; defense value.” (a comma is added after “creature” (“character, creature, or vehicle”)).

The whole 2018 image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
